patient._comment: 'patient' contains the three sections that may be exposed in the detailed patient display: presentation, answer, and clinical.

presentation._comment: The immutable patient evidence package available for triage. Panel context controls whether other sections are locked or available.
presentation.quote: (Mom) She's got a runny nose and a little cough for a couple days, low-grade temp, but she's eating, drinking, and running around like normal. My daycare said to get her checked.
presentation.triageNote: 5-year-old female with two days of a runny nose, mild cough, and low-grade temperature. She remains playful, is eating and drinking normally, has no breathing difficulty, and has an otherwise normal examination.

answer._comment: The authoritative game answer. Explicit ESI, destination, and destination rationale are answer-bearing content; the player's assignment remains session state.
answer.destinationReason: ESI 5 is appropriate because this playful, hydrated child with an uncomplicated cold requires no counted emergency resource.

clinical._comment: Display-ready clinical interpretation derived from patient.presentation. It preserves clinical meaning but must not explicitly name or identify the correct ESI level or destination; it does not participate in scoring.
clinical.summary: This child has mild upper-respiratory symptoms with normal intake, activity, breathing, and examination.
clinical.acuityReason: The well appearance and absence of respiratory distress or dehydration support supportive outpatient care.
teachingPoints: Work of breathing, dehydration, persistent high fever, lethargy, or significant worsening should prompt reassessment.
Antibiotics do not treat an uncomplicated viral cold.

possibleClinicalOutcome.disposition: Reassurance, fluids, symptom treatment, and return guidance would allow discharge without testing.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.
aiImageGeneration.pose: wiggly on the chair, a tissue in hand
aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style: smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines (NOT thick flat cartoon outlines), warm detailed rendering, natural realistic proportions, single character, 3/4 front view, centered, square 1:1. Match the exact painterly style, brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting, and palette of the attached reference image. Subject: a black 5-year-old girl, bright and playful, seated on a blue padded clinic chair. Pose: wiggly and energetic, a tissue in one hand. Expression: cheerful despite a runny nose. Clearly visible: a lively, well child holding a tissue. No text, no logos.
